Issue: Customer unable to access online banking portal after password reset.
Solution: Walked customer through clearing browser cache and resetting credentials. Access restored.
AdditionalDetails: Customer was using Internet Explorer - recommended Chrome.

Issue: Payment not reflected on account after 3 business days.
Solution: Confirmed payment was posted. Delay due to weekend processing cutoff. Advised customer.
AdditionalDetails: Customer was frustrated - offered to waive next late fee as courtesy.

Issue: Loan payoff amount requested for refinance with another institution.
Solution: Provided payoff quote valid for 30 days. Emailed confirmation to customer.
AdditionalDetails: Customer mentioned they were shopping rates - noted in file.

Issue: Unauthorized charge of $47.50 appearing on account.
Solution: Investigated and confirmed charge was fraudulent. Initiated dispute and provisional credit.
AdditionalDetails: Referred to fraud department for full investigation.

Issue: Request to update mailing address on all accounts.
Solution: Address updated across all accounts and loans. Confirmation mailed to new address.
AdditionalDetails: Customer recently moved - updated in core system.

Issue: Inquiry about current CD rates and terms available.
Solution: Provided current rate sheet. Customer interested in 12-month CD.
AdditionalDetails: Transferred to new accounts to open CD.

Issue: Direct deposit not received on expected pay date.
Solution: Confirmed employer ACH was received but held for review. Released same day.
AdditionalDetails: New employer - first direct deposit flagged by system.

Issue: Debit card declined at point of sale despite sufficient funds.
Solution: Card was flagged for unusual activity. Verified with customer and unlocked card.
AdditionalDetails: Customer was traveling out of state - reminded to set travel notice.

Issue: Request for loan payment history for tax purposes.
Solution: Printed and mailed 12-month payment history. Also emailed PDF copy.

Issue: Overdraft fee dispute - claims auto-transfer should have covered.
Solution: Reviewed account - auto-transfer was set up but insufficient funds in linked account.
AdditionalDetails: Waived one fee as first-time courtesy. Reviewed auto-transfer settings with customer.
